plugin.name: Rascal Debugger
plugin.description:
Works with any Maven-based Rascal project. Does NOT provide Rascal syntax highlighting or editing (diagnostics/completion/CodeLenses) by itself -- see this repo's own README for those two separate, required one-time setup steps before installing this.

Implements the rascalmpl.importModule / rascalmpl.runMain LSP commands -- the CodeLenses Rascal's LSP server emits above module and main() declarations -- for LSP4IJ. Also auto-discovers the Rascal debug port on run and attaches LSP4IJ's DAP configuration automatically, no manual port lookup or config editing needed. Also bridges Rascal's std:/// location scheme to IntelliJ's VFS, so "Go to Definition" into standard library symbols (IO, List, Set, String, util::FileSystem, etc.) works instead of silently failing. Registers a "Rascal Debugger" DAP server that fixes a per-file breakpoint sync bug in LSP4IJ 0.21.0's stock DAP breakpoint handler (disabling one breakpoint while another was active elsewhere in the project never stopped the debugger from breaking at the disabled one).
plugin.change-notes:
0.6.0
  • Works with any Maven-based Rascal project now: "Import"/"Run in new Rascal terminal" computes its classpath from whatever project is open, via that project's own pom.xml, instead of requiring a specific script to exist inside it.
  • run-rsc-lsp.sh/run-ptl-lsp.sh/compute-classpath.sh (also hosted in this repo) support an ADEPT_BASE_ROOT override, so a copy can run pointed at a project checkout other than the one it physically lives in.
0.5.0
  • Renamed to "Rascal Debugger".
  • Fixed a real LSP4IJ 0.21.0 bug where disabling/removing a breakpoint while another was active anywhere else in the project never notified the debug adapter, so execution kept stopping at the disabled breakpoint. Requires selecting "Rascal Debugger" (not the generic entry) in your DAP run configuration's server dropdown -- see this project's README.
  • Classpath computation is now derived dynamically from Maven instead of hardcoded jar paths, fixing a NoClassDefFoundError on "Run/Import in new Rascal terminal" when the hardcoded paths were stale.
0.2.0
  • Fixed "Go to Definition" into Rascal standard library symbols (e.g. IO::println, List::size) by bridging the std:/// location scheme to IntelliJ's VFS.
